archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: SAP BI
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation: Provides reporting capability for eFin, since eFin has no native reporting of its own. Connects with direct database access rather than through an API or reporting-specific interface, meaning changes to the eFin database schema carry risk of breaking SAP BI reports.

properties.value: Direct DB access (read) — no reporting API
Tightly coupled to eFin DB schema; no abstraction layer
